name: Routing — ModelGateway, NonOpenAI provider
summary: ModelGateway connection (distinct from ApiManagement) fronting an OpenRouter / LiteLLM / DeepSeek backend.
description: A `ModelGateway` connection is a BYOM connection category distinct from `ApiManagement`, with `modelDiscovery` and model `format` values such as `OpenAI`, `Anthropic`, `NonOpenAI`, and `Deepseek`. It targets users who want Foundry to route `{connection}/{deployment}` through the ModelGateway connection type instead of APIM.
notes:
Not yet confirmed against Foundry for non-OpenAI ModelGateway routing. Docs for AI Gateway connections: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway. See `test.py` for the `AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_MODELGATEWAY` probe.

Technical facts preserved: `ModelGateway` supports OAuth2 `client_credentials`, while `ApiManagement` supports AAD/MI; the two routing paths are not interchangeable.
